in-hc-gauhati.description: High Court for Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Nagaland, seated at Guwahati. Permanent/circuit bench(es) at: Aizawl (permanent); Itanagar (permanent); Kohima (permanent). Sanctioned judge strength 30 (22 permanent + 8 additional); 26 in position, 4 vacant as of the Dept. of Justice statement dated 2026-07-01 (cross-checked against Wikipedia data current to 2026-09-25). Senior-most puisne (non-Chief) judge as of 2026-09-25: Justice Michael Zothankhuma.

holder.notes: Immediately preceding posting: Chief Justice, Patna High Court.
